# American Association for Physician Leadership (AAPL)

> AAPL is the premier organization dedicated to physician and provider leadership transformation through certification, education, and professional networking.

AAPL offers comprehensive leadership development programs including the flagship Certified Physician Executive (CPE) credential, specialized academies for CMOs and inter-professional teams, and CME-accredited courses. The organization serves physicians at all career stages through membership, conferences, assessments, and published resources.

## Key Topics

- Certified Physician Executive (CPE)
- Chief Medical Officer (CMO)
- Physician Leadership
- Healthcare Management
- Executive Education
- Professional Development
- Leadership Certification
- Career Advancement
- CME Credits
- Healthcare Administration
- AAPL Helix Community
- Leadership Assessment
- Inter-Professional Leadership
- Physician Development
- Medical Education

## Credentials & Certification

- [Certified Physician Executive (CPE)](https://www.physicianleaders.org/credentials/cpe): CPE credential: AAPL's flagship physician executive certification program.
- [CMO Academy 2026/2027 Cohort](https://www.physicianleaders.org/cmo-academy): Chief Medical Officer Academy: 12-month certificate program for aspiring CMOs.
- [Inter-Professional Leadership Academy (ILA)](https://www.physicianleaders.org/inter-professional-leadership-academy): Inter-Professional Leadership Academy: 6-month dyad training for physician/nurse leaders.

## Education & Development Programs

- [AAPL Accelerators](https://www.physicianleaders.org/accelerators): AAPL Accelerators: CME-earning courses and workshops for physician leadership development.
- [Advanced CMO Accelerator](https://shop.physicianleaders.org/products/advanced-cmo-accelerator): Advanced CMO Accelerator: Two-day immersive program for experienced CMOs.
- [Education for Early Career](https://www.physicianleaders.org/education/early-career): Early career physician education: Leadership fundamentals and mentoring programs.
- [The AAPL Experience](https://www.physicianleaders.org/education/experience): AAPL Experience overview: CPE, capstone, and master's program pathways.

## Membership & Community

- [Membership](https://www.physicianleaders.org/membership): AAPL membership: Benefits, networking, and access to leadership resources.
- [Annual Leadership Conference](https://www.physicianleaders.org/conference): AAPL Annual Leadership Conference: Scottsdale 2026 keynotes and networking.
- [Schedule Advising Session](https://www.physicianleaders.org/schedule-advising-session): Schedule advising session with AAPL education advisor for career guidance.

## Organizational Solutions & Services

- [AAPL Solutions](https://www.physicianleaders.org/aapl-solutions): AAPL Solutions: Enterprise physician leadership programs for organizations and teams.
- [Assessment Products](https://www.physicianleaders.org/assessments): AAPL assessment products: Leadership and technical skills evaluation tools.
- [AAPL Assessment](https://www.physicianleaders.org/assessment): AAPL Assessment: Myers-Briggs and personality tools for physician development.
